classification.difficultyReason: Read two zeroes from each graph, construct the corresponding factors and choose the permitted leading coefficient using concavity.

content.prompt: Write down, in factored form, the equation of each quadratic function $y=f(x)$ sketched below. In each case, the coefficient of $x^2$ is either 1 or $-1$.

spec.description: Unshaded upward-opening parabola through the origin and the labelled x-intercept 3. Positive axes and both curve ends have arrowheads; no grid or origin label.
spec.mathematics: The curve is y=x(x-3), with vertex (3/2,-9/4). Only the source intercept label is displayed.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph is visible; its equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The zeroes are 0 and 3, so the factors are $x$ and $x-3$. The curve is concave up, so the coefficient of $x^2$ is 1.
$$f(x)=x(x-3).$$

spec.description: Unshaded upward-opening parabola with labelled x-intercepts -2 and 1 and y-intercept -2. Positive axes and both curve ends have arrowheads; no grid.
spec.mathematics: The curve is y=(x+2)(x-1), with vertex (-1/2,-9/4).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph and intercepts are visible; its equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The zeroes are $-2$ and 1, so the factors are $x+2$ and $x-1$. The curve is concave up, so the coefficient of $x^2$ is 1.
$$f(x)=(x+2)(x-1).$$
At $x=0$, this gives $f(0)=-2$, agreeing with the graph.

spec.description: Unshaded downward-opening parabola with labelled x-intercepts -1 and 3 and y-intercept 3. Positive axes and both descending curve ends have arrowheads; no grid.
spec.mathematics: The curve is y=-(x+1)(x-3), with vertex (1,4).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph and intercepts are visible; its equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The zeroes are $-1$ and 3, so the factors are $x+1$ and $x-3$. The curve is concave down, so the coefficient of $x^2$ is $-1$.
$$f(x)=-(x+1)(x-3).$$
At $x=0$, this gives $f(0)=3$, agreeing with the graph.

spec.description: Unshaded downward-opening parabola with labelled x-intercepts -5 and -2 and y-intercept -10. Positive axes and both descending curve ends have arrowheads; no grid.
spec.mathematics: The curve is y=-(x+5)(x+2), with vertex (-7/2,9/4).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph and intercepts are visible; its equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The zeroes are $-5$ and $-2$, so the factors are $x+5$ and $x+2$. The curve is concave down, so the coefficient of $x^2$ is $-1$.
$$f(x)=-(x+5)(x+2).$$
At $x=0$, this gives $f(0)=-10$, agreeing with the graph.
